summary: Enhance your skills with our Data Visualization Training Course. Learn to create impactful visuals and make data-driven decisions effectively.
lede: Data visualization helps analysts and reporting professionals turn datasets into clear, accessible charts and dashboards for decision-making. This training is for people who create, review, or use visual reports, and covers profiling data, choosing suitable chart forms, building interactive dashboards, checking accessibility, and presenting findings without overstating what the evidence shows.
audienceIntro: This Data Visualization Training course is designed for professionals who create, review, govern, or act on charts, dashboards, and visual reports. It supports the following data visualization roles and adjacent reporting responsibilities:
modules: Data Visualization Foundations with Grammar of Graphics
Data Visualization Design with Gestalt Principles
Dashboard Construction in a BI Tool
Visual Analytics in a BI Tool
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop capable of running the agreed lab software and have basic experience working with rows, columns, formulas, or recurring reports. Coding is not required for course completion. Power Query, basic DAX, Power BI, and Tableau receive hands-on operational coverage, while AI-assisted recommendations and advanced analytics receive conceptual awareness only.
